calls.title: 4.4 check-in
calls.summary: The team discussed revisions to the product launch blog post, aiming to balance marketing narrative with technical details to appeal to various customer segments. Key changes include a lighter tone in the blog intro for better communication about AI integration and distinct styles for launch posts versus release notes. The inclusion of a founder’s note was agreed upon to add authenticity, while transparency about the release's complexity was emphasized alongside light humor. The release details three of the top five AI labs for credibility and plans to target a 'What’s New' section in-app for improved user access to updates. Additionally, commitments were made for completing a bug bash to ensure release stability and for using quantitative stats to illustrate the release's magnitude.
calls.keywords: AI experimentation, product launch, release notes, marketing collateral, Growth Book 4.4, customer communication
